//: flow-hotfix.json — Track 0 极速通道（#hotfix / 微调：改动 <=3 文件、无 API/DB/类型契约变更）。
//usage: node .orca/flow.mjs --config flow-hotfix.json "#hotfix <问题描述与复现方式>"
//switch: 切换轨道：Track 0 (--config flow-hotfix.json) | Track 1 (默认 flow.config.json / --config flow-feature.json) | Track 2 (--config flow-epic.json)
//workflow: 完全跳过 PO / Backlog -> Red->Green 测试先行最小修复 -> GPT-6.2 Sol (High) 极速 Diff 审计 (Max Retry=2) -> 单测绿灯 + 提 PR 触发 CI（不直推/不自动合并 main）。

//modelPool.hotfix-coding: 主力 DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (High, OpenCode Go；疑难 Bug 可切 Max)，或切换 gemini / gemini-4-neon (Medium，禁止对 Carbon/Neon 开 Low)。
//modelPool.diff-audit: GPT-6.2 Sol (High, Codex CLI；绝对不要开 Max，避免实测负优化与额度浪费)。
//modelPool.pr-ci-submit: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 (Low) 或 Hy4 flash / Gemini 4 Hydrogen (Low/Medium)。
//modelPool.ciFallback: 远端 CI 无头审 PR 兜底使用腾讯 TokenHub API (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 / Hy4 flash)，严禁在 CI Runner 中使用个人订阅账号。

pipeline.title: Hotfix Red->Green Fix
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 0 (#hotfix) fast-path engineer. Skip PO/Backlog completely. Scope guard: keep changes <= 3 files with NO API/DB/TypeScript contract changes (if the issue actually requires contract changes or >3 files, stop and report outcome=failed recommending Track 1/2). FIRST ACTION - TASK CHECKLIST: write a concise Markdown checklist to {tasks} ('- [ ]' / '- [~]' / '- [x]') and keep it updated live. MANDATORY RED->GREEN WORKFLOW: (1) RED: write a minimal failing regression test that reproduces the exact bug and run it to confirm it FAILS for the expected reason; (2) GREEN: apply the smallest surgical code fix so the regression test and existing unit tests PASS; (3) run lint/typecheck/unit-test locally (stateless checks only). If re-run after a failed diff-audit, read HOTFIX_AUDIT.md and fix every BLOCKER/MAJOR finding. Write {out} with: root cause, red-test evidence, green-test evidence, changed files (<=3), and verification commands.

pipeline.title: Fast Diff Audit (GPT-6.2 Sol)
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 0 cross-family senior diff auditor (GPT-6.2 Sol, High effort — NEVER Max). Inspect the git diff and {reads}. Verify strictly: (1) scope <= 3 files and zero contract changes; (2) genuine Red->Green regression test exists and passes; (3) no security regressions, side effects, or test-cheating. Write {out} with severity-grouped findings (BLOCKER/MAJOR/MINOR) and a clear VERDICT at the end: if any BLOCKER/MAJOR exists, report FAIL (outcome=failed) to loop back to hotfix-coding (hard cap Max Retry = 2); otherwise PASS.

pipeline.title: Unit Test Green & Open PR
pipeline.spec: You are a Track 0 release assistant. Based on {reads}: (1) re-verify local unit tests are green; (2) ensure HEAD is on a hotfix/<slug> branch (NEVER push directly to main/master and NEVER auto-merge to main); (3) commit clean changes if uncommitted (exclude .orca/artifacts/), push the branch (`git push -u origin HEAD`), and create/update a Pull Request targeting main (using `gh pr create` or `tea pr create` if available, otherwise output the exact PR title/body and CLI command); (4) summarize the Chinese PR description and CI trigger status in {out}.
